name: Fixing Condition
definition: Set of parameters used to calculate a rate for instance the fixing rate to be applied to a non-deliverable agreement.

FixingDateTime.name: Fixing Date Time
FixingDateTime.definition: Date and time at which a rate is observed.

SettlementRateOption.name: Settlement Rate Option
SettlementRateOption.definition: Source used for determining the fixing rate, as provided by various financial publishing organisations.

FinancialCenter.name: Financial Center
FinancialCenter.definition: Financial place taken into account to adjust the date and time, as defined within the business day convention.

DisruptionFallback.name: Disruption Fallback
DisruptionFallback.definition: Method that gives rise to either an alternative basis for determining the settlement rate, or an alternative basis for settling a transaction when a disruption event has occurred.

BusinessDayConvention.name: Business Day Convention
BusinessDayConvention.definition: Convention used for adjusting a date when it is not a business day.

NonDeliverableTrade.name: Non Deliverable Trade
NonDeliverableTrade.definition: Non Deliverable trade for which fixing conditions are specified.

FixingRate.name: Fixing Rate
FixingRate.definition: Rate obtained at fixing time by following the fixing conditions (agreed upon by the trading parties).
